evals.name: park-from-conversation
evals.prompt: (After a conversation about a slow reports dashboard and an idea of a 5-minute TTL cache) Park this for later.
evals.expected_output: Shows a table preview, and after approval creates one file in <repo root>/docs/backlog/ in the given format.
expectations: Before saving shows the preview table with the target directory and waits for approval
The file is created in <repo root>/docs/backlog/, not in the current subdirectory
File name: English, kebab-case, max 50 characters
Frontmatter has title, type (optimization), date from context or date +%F, source
Content only from the conversation; sections without coverage omitted; History last with a created entry
No git operations

evals.name: nothing-to-park
evals.expected_output: Says there is nothing to park; creates no files or directories.
expectations: Says there is nothing to park
Creates no file or directory

evals.name: dedup
evals.prompt: (After a conversation about caching for reports, Redis as the decision) Park this.
evals.expected_output: Detects the existing docs/backlog/cache-for-report-queries.md, asks: append or new file; appending fits the content into sections and adds a History entry.
expectations: Before the preview points to the similar existing file and asks: append or new
After choosing append no new file is created
Appended content without repetition, in matching sections
A new History line with a date

evals.name: sanitization
evals.prompt: (The conversation contains a client's surname, e-mail, phone, an API token, and an internal host) Park the integration idea.
evals.expected_output: A file without sensitive data; the preview marks what was anonymised.
expectations: Grepping the saved file for the surname, e-mail, phone, token, and host gives 0 hits
Applies to the file name, source, and tags too
The preview says what was anonymised

evals.name: review-and-return
evals.prompt: What do I have parked? And then: let's go back to the cache one.
evals.expected_output: A table of items, newest on top, an item with a moved entry marked → plan <slug>; return summarises the file without changing it.
expectations: Table: date, type, title, file; newest on top
An item with "moved to plan <slug>" in History has the suffix → plan <slug>
Return: a short summary, file unchanged (checksum comparison)

evals.name: review-empty
expectations: Answers that nothing is parked
The docs/backlog/ directory still does not exist
